notes.title: Re-Enter The Darkness (Bug Fix)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
[b]A bug was present in the game preventing you from finishing it, it is now fixed![/b]

If you want more details about it and how it passed my vigilance, it is an issue in Godot due to a filename going from "glassWall" to "GlassWall". Some files, including the first one in "The Darkness" level, were still referencing the old one.

If the editor seems to not be case-sensitive on loading a file, it is now clear that the Windows build was.

Hoping you'll enjoy the second part of the adventure (it was blocking 40% of the content...)

Le DoubleSept

notes.title: The 3.1 version is out!
notes.notes:
Hi :)
I just released a new version of the game (v3.1) that fixes a lot of small (and bigger) bugs.

[list]
[*]     The most important change is on the way the block moves, as they now try to reach your mouse position at all time.
[*]     Some levels that were really to long has been simplified (mainly on advanced levels)
[*]     Some levels that were not playable due to a bug are no playable again
[/list]

I tried to test this version way more intensively that the previous one but if you still find a bug let me know.

This 3.1 version should be the last one before a big, big update (allegedly bigger than the 2.0->3.0 update)
